name: Basophil
description: A type of white blood cell involved in inflammatory and allergic responses.

name: Monocyte
description: The largest type of white blood cell, precursors to macrophages.

name: Seg_neutrophil
description: Segmented Neutrophil; a mature white blood cell essential for fighting infection.

name: Erythroblast
description: An immature red blood cell normally found in the bone marrow. Presence in blood can indicate stress or disease.

name: Normal
description: Standard mature blood cell morphology with no significant abnormalities detected.

name: Myeloblast
description: Immature white blood cell; abnormal presence in blood is a primary indicator of leukemia.
